methodology: Polymer nanoparticles were synthesized using Lung cancer N,N'-methylenbisacrylamide (BIS) as a cross-linker, with cannabidiol (CBD) co-polymerized into the polymeric structure.
research_objective: Synthesis and characterization of a poly-4-Vinyl pyridine-co-cannabidiol polymer for antitumor activity evaluation.

key_findings.finding: The polymeric drug system retains the cytotoxic and antiproliferative effects of CBD.
Solubility in water of the solid@poly-4VP-co-CBD was analyzed.
The synthesis and characterization of poly-4VP-co-CBD solid nanoparticles were conducted, along with the analysis of invitro cytotoxicity against human and mouse tumor cell lines.
